title: Reported February25 parliament-side tent camp with March presence
location: Marshal Bagramian Avenue beside parliament, Yerevan
possible_owner_unit: armenia_2021-02 and/or armenia_2021-03; exact ownership and end unresolved
notes: RFE/RL retrospective dates HSM’s camp setup to February25; opened February26 Armenpress S043 says demonstrators spent the night on Baghramyan Avenue and set up tents. Opened March1 S046 and March9 S045 reports document later discrete HSM protests at Baghramyan; S045 says the avenue remained blocked on March9. Search-only S048 identifies a March23 report that Baghramyan was unblocked after weeks of protest and says tents on Demirchyan would serve as movement headquarters. These sources do not establish daily uninterrupted occupation, exact ownership of the camp, a camp end date, or the February25 threshold. February26–27 and March rallies remain distinct action candidates.
